kinds.outcome: A documented result; the method behind it is not published

cases.what: 2023-25 final placements: 130 recruiters took part. Consulting was 28% of offers, sales and marketing 21%, finance and general management 18% each. Named consulting recruiters include Bain, Deloitte USI, EY India, Accenture Strategy and Everest Group; finance recruiters include Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, HSBC and Nomura.
cases.adapt: Use this recruiter list as the target list for the sectors your students say are missing.

cases.what: 2024-26 batch: more than 180 recruiters took part, over 100 of them first-time recruiters, and 409 students received final offers. The campus is in a similarly non-metro location.
Its 2023 placement report lists 125+ participating companies, 65+ of them new recruiters. The recruiter base roughly doubled again by 2025 (about 250).
2023-25: median ₹25 L, average ₹26.44 L. The average sits only about 6% above the median, so offers are not top-heavy.
A standing Placement Preparation Committee covering interview preparation, skill development, aptitude and assessment preparation, and personalised career counselling.
Second-year students run a mentorship programme each year for first-years to prepare them for the summer placement process; group-discussion and interview preparation is a stated priority.
cases.adapt: A senior-to-junior mentorship costs little and can start before the placement season.

cases.what: The Disha Placement Preparation Cell develops professional competencies including CV writing, communication, group discussion and mock practice.

Second-year students with household income of ₹8 L or less can apply for a tuition waiver in two tiers: 100% and 25%. At least 2% of the batch (rounded up) is guaranteed the 100% waiver and at least 6% the 25% waiver. Applicants are scored 30% first-year CGPA, 30% admission merit and 40% household income. Government scholarships through the National Scholarship Portal are listed alongside.
cases.adapt: The guaranteed percentages make the scheme predictable for applicants and easy to publish.

src.t: IIM Visakhapatnam: financial aid and scholarships

cases.what: Students with household income below ₹6 L can apply for a tuition waiver (others with severe financial difficulty may also apply). The amount depends on an assessment of need. A student may take institute aid or a government ministry scholarship, not both.

src.t: IIM Udaipur MBA: fees and financing

cases.what: A financial aid programme reported to give 20-100% fee waivers to households earning under ₹8 L, decided in a two-stage review in which CAT score plays no part.
Lists nine loan partners: Bank of Baroda, Bank of India, Canara Bank, Central Bank of India, Credila, Punjab National Bank, State Bank of India, UCO Bank and Union Bank of India.
cases.adapt: A named list of partner banks lets admitted students compare loan terms before they enrol.

src.t: IIM Visakhapatnam: financial aid and scholarships

cases.what: Points admitted students to the Vidya Lakshmi Portal, the government single-window platform for education loans from multiple banks.

src.t: IIM Udaipur MBA: fees and financing

cases.what: Its fee waiver is tuition-only, so hostel, mess and living costs stay with the student. None of the peers reviewed publishes a subsidy for those costs.

src.t: IIM Visakhapatnam: financial aid and scholarships

cases.what: 2025 summer internship stipends reported: IIM Rohtak about ₹1.21 L average per month, IIM Ranchi about ₹1.3-1.6 L, IIM Shillong about ₹1.9-2.0 L. The sources disagree on batches and averages.
Advertised Professor and Associate Professor of Practice positions in 2024, bringing practitioners into the permanent faculty.

src.t: IIM Sirmaur: Professor of Practice advertisement

cases.what: Runs a rolling advertisement for Faculty of Practice positions, to keep pace with management practice in the corporate and policy sectors.
Hires accomplished industry professionals full time as Professors of Practice, expected to teach across programmes, write cases and build links with organisations.

src.t: IIM Indore Professor of Practice recruitment 2026

cases.what: Invited government officials and executives to apply for faculty roles.

src.t: People Matters: IIM Ahmedabad invites officials, executives for new faculty

cases.what: Faculty listed in NIRF grew from 32 (2021) to 81 (2026). The share with a Ph.D. fell from 100% to 87.7% over the same period, the trade-off of hiring fast.
Faculty listed in NIRF grew from 12 (2021) to 74 (2026) while keeping a Ph.D. share of about 95%.
Faculty listed in NIRF grew from 42 (2021) to 98 (2026) and the students-per-faculty ratio fell from 12.6 to 7.7.
A Centre for Teaching and Learning supports faculty and doctoral students with teaching inputs, helps build teaching cases and notes, and runs a webinar series on teaching.

src.t: IIM Bangalore: Centre for Teaching and Learning

cases.what: A Faculty Development Programme running since 1979 trains educators in the case method, case writing and classroom effectiveness.

src.t: Careers360: IIM Ahmedabad faculty development programme

cases.what: An annual five-week FDP plus shorter formats, with a teaching track on participant-centred learning, teaching through cases and simulation-based teaching.
Already runs a Faculty Development Programme aimed at management educators who want to learn and experiment with effective pedagogy.

One Nation One Subscription, live since 1 January 2025, gives central and state universities, colleges and central R&D institutions access to more than 13,000 e-journals from 30 international publishers, funded to December 2027. IIMs are not named in the sources found, so check eligibility on the ONOS portal.

src.t: Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser: One Nation One Subscription

cases.what: Its faculty advertisements expect a good publication record in ABDC or ABS journals (Scopus, Scimago or Web of Science for liberal arts candidates), setting the research standard at the point of hiring.
Reported to pay ₹5 L for an ABDC A* publication; other business schools pay on a tiered scale.

src.t: Careers360: Indian B-schools must set their own gold standards for research

cases.what: Journal articles in OpenAlex rose from 17 (2021) to 88 (2025) as faculty grew from 12 to 74. The research policy behind this is not published.
A Research Incentive Plan, including a grant-based incentive when faculty bring in external funding.

In 2017 it gave female candidates an additional 5% cut-off reduction when calling for interviews, then ranked everyone on a common merit list. Before 2017 women were under 11% of MBA classes across the IIMs; its 10th batch (2024-26) was 76% women (244 of 320). The 2025-27 batch was 33% women, so the share can swing year to year.
cases.adapt: A lower interview-call cut-off keeps one merit list and needs no extra seats.

cases.what: The first IIM to add supernumerary seats for women, 60 in 2018, so the intake is guaranteed whatever the admission criteria are.

src.t: Careers360: How IIM Kozhikode changed the game

cases.what: Its 2026 admissions policy reserves 40 seats for female applicants through a separate admission route. Some aggregator pages say 60 supernumerary seats; the institute's own policy text says forty (40). The effect will show from the 2026-28 batch.
Reported to add about 4% weightage as a gender-diversity factor when deciding the interview list.

src.t: Careers360: Women in IIMs, levelling the field

cases.what: Reserves no seats for women and instead ran outreach activities over three years to improve gender diversity in the batch, according to its director.

src.t: Careers360: Women in IIMs, levelling the field

cases.what: Its Student Exchange Programme has run since 2014 and reports about 100 exchange students from over 60 business schools and about 200 international students from more than 30 countries. The page is undated.
Signed its first foreign exchange MoU with ALBA (Greece) for a trimester-long exchange at no extra academic fee, and says it is negotiating with more institutions.
Signed an MoU with Clark University (USA) in 2025 and runs a Student Exchange Programme with partner institutions.

src.t: Morung Express: IIM Shillong inks MoU with Clark University USA

cases.what: A Committee for Managing Gender Issues (CMGI), set up under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act.

UGC guidelines require women's cells in higher education institutions, and its Saksham report is recommended as a handbook for gender-sensitisation programmes, including enough hostel places for women who need them.

src.t: Careers360: UGC notifies guidelines to set up women cell in institutes

gaps.s1: No institute publishes how it won a new recruiter sector. The cases above are results; ask the placement committees at Shillong and Bodh Gaya how they approached first-time recruiters.
gaps.s2: No institute documents a method for moving offers from sales and operations roles into consulting or finance.
gaps.s3: No documented method for lifting the median specifically.
gaps.s4: Finance, valuation and technical preparation have no documented programme at the peers reviewed.
gaps.s5: No institute documents a remote-campus placement process or a city office.
gaps.s6: No peer documents how it negotiates higher pay for the same role.
gaps.r3: No peer documents a hostel or living-cost subsidy.
gaps.r4: No documented peer measure for faster post-MBA pay growth.
gaps.f1: Department-level vacancy data is not public. Compare each department's faculty page with its course list.
gaps.f3: No IIM publishes a faculty retention policy.
gaps.f6: No documented measure beyond adding faculty.
gaps.x1: No IIM publishes teaching-load relief for research.
gaps.x2: No documented student research-assistant scheme at the peers reviewed.
gaps.x6: No documented seminar or visiting-scholar programme at the peers reviewed.
gaps.d3: No documented practice on regional diversity of faculty.
gaps.d4: No documented practice on widening the home states of students.
gaps.d6: Only Rohtak's outreach and Sirmaur's own admission route are documented.
